Core Components & Lazy Loading Strategy** **Main Component:** [IconPicker.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/IconPicker.vue#L1-L150) The picker uses **four async-loaded manifests** loaded on mount: - [cdn-icon-manifest-instui.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-instui.json) — InstUI icons (mixed Lucide + custom sources) - [cdn-icon-manifest-lucide-lab.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-lucide-lab.json) — Lucide Lab set - [cdn-icon-manifest-simple.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-simple.json) — Simple Icons brand slugs (~4.7 MB raw, ~1.8 MB gzip per script) - [cdn-plugin-manifest.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-plugin-manifest.json) — Custom components, plugins, logos **Manifest Load Pattern:** Each loads separately with error handling, showing "Loading icon list…" state. Deep-linking (URL hash) allows state restoration once manifests arrive. --- ### **2. Glyph Rendering CSS Mechanism** The icon display uses a **three-layer CSS system**: #### **Layer 1: Icon Tokens** — [icons.css](formats/components/dist/icons.css) Contains 1800+ `--instui-icon-` custom properties, each holding an inline SVG data-URI: ```css :root { --instui-icon-check: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...%3E'); --instui-icon-chevron-down: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...%3E'); /* ... 1800+ more ... */ } ``` #### **Layer 2: Glyph Classifiers** — [icon-glyphs.ts](formats/components/src/utilities/icon-glyphs/index.ts#L42-L60) Generated by `iconGlyphsCss()`, creates one class per icon: ```css .-icon-check { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-icon-check); } .-icon-chevron-down { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-icon-chevron-down); } /* The -render-icon-* deprecated aliases also exist when built with deprecatedAliases: true */ ``` #### **Layer 3: Painter Utility** — [icon.css](formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css#L15-L23) The shared `::before` pseudo-element that renders all glyphs: ```css [class*="-icon-"]::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; vertical-align: -0.125em; background: currentColor; -webkit-mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; } ``` **Key technique:** The `mask` property (with `-webkit` prefix for older browsers) uses the SVG data-URI as a mask image. ## Plan: Replace TinyMCE emoticons icon picker with a custom dialog

**Why it's broken.** Three separate defects, verified in the built CSS:

1. **Black squares = missing token values.** [formats/components/dist/icons.css](formats/components/dist/icons.css) — the sheet the plugin injects — only contains the *mapping* `.-icon-heart{--pantoken-glyph:var(--instui-icon-heart)}`. It never defines `--instui-icon-heart`. The per-icon file [formats/components/dist/icons/heart.css](formats/components/dist/icons/heart.css) *is* self-contained. So the mask resolves to nothing and `background: currentColor` paints a solid 1em square — for all ~1,400 Instructure UI icons. The three plugin bundles inline their `:root` tokens, which is why brand/Lucide glyphs do render.
2. **Painter rule never injected.** `[class*="-icon-"]::before` lives in `components.css`, not in any of the four injected sheets. It only works today by accident.
3. **Layout.** Emoticons sizes `.tox-collection__item` for one emoji character; wide wordmark SVGs blow out the grid.

Scale: ~6,827 icons (components 1,401 · simple-icons 4,175 · lucide-lab 1,239 · custom 12), all already bundled into the TinyMCE JS.

**Steps**

**Phase 1 — Data layer** (`renderers/tinymce/src/icons.ts`)
1. Drop `EmoticonEntry`, `buildEmoticonsDatabase`, `PANTOKEN_ICONS_DATABASE_ID`, `matchInsertedIcon`. Keep `TaggedIcon`, `loadAllIcons`, `getIconCdnFile`, `buildIconMarkup`.
2. Add pure `filterIcons(icons, query, source)` and `SOURCE_LABELS`.
3. Add `getIconDataUri(icon)` — pulls the inline SVG from `rebrandTokens` / custom-icons embedded data (reusing `decodeIconToken` from [renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts)); `undefined` for simple-icons and lucide-lab.

**Phase 2 — Preview CSS** (new `lib/icon-preview-css.ts`) — *depends on 3*
4. One idempotent `injectPickerStyles(doc)` that adds: the painter rule **scoped to the picker root** so it can't leak into the host page; a generated `<style>` of `:root{--instui-icon-*}` built from in-bundle data (zero network); and `<link>`s for only the two self-contained bundles that aren't in the JS. Opening the dialog then costs 2 requests, none per icon.

**Phase 3 — Dialog DOM** (new `lib/icon-picker-dom.ts`)
5. `renderPickerMarkup()` — search input, source tab row, scrollable grid, live count, load-more sentinel, all under a `pantoken-ip__*` namespace with its own CSS.
6. `mountPicker(root, icons, { onPick })` — debounced search, tab filtering, 200-tile chunks appended via IntersectionObserver, roving-tabindex keyboard nav. Build tiles with `document.createElement`, not string interpolation, so icon names can't inject markup. Returns `{ destroy() }`.

**Phase 4 — Plugin rewrite** (`renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts`)
7. `windowManager.open` with a single `htmlpanel`, `presets: "presentation"`; mount on open, `destroy()` on close. Mirrors the dialog shape already used in [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/components.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/components.ts).
8. On pick: `insertHtml` via `lib/insertion-target.ts` + `trackAndInjectAsset`. The `ExecCommand`/`data-pantoken-icon` round trip disappears — we know the icon directly.
9. Keep the `pantokenIcons` button and menu item.
10. `addAutocompleter` with a configurable `trigger`, default `"::"`. TinyMCE merges results across autocompleters sharing a trigger, so `:` must stay free for the stock emoji plugin. Items use `cardmenuitem` + `CardImage` with the SVG data URI as `src` where available.

**Phase 5 — Integration**
11. New strings in `strings.ts` + `l10n/tinymce.strings.pot`.
12. Update `plugins/pantoken.ts` and `src/index.ts`.
13. Grep out `emoticons` / `emoticons_database_id` from demos, README, `ai/pantoken-ai`, scaffold templates.
14. Changeset; amend `ASSURANCE.md` for the new runtime-`<style>` and htmlpanel surfaces.

**Verification**
1. Package unit tests (happy-dom): `filterIcons`, `getIconDataUri`, tile-construction escaping, chunking.
2. `vp check --fix`, `vp run ready`, `pnpm run check:publish`; `vp test --coverage` last (≥85%).
3. **Manual browser pass (required — the bug is visual):** no black squares in the Instructure UI tab; uniform square tiles; smooth scroll through 6.8k icons; search spans sources; picked icon renders in the body *and* in CodeMirror source view.
4. Network panel: exactly 2 stylesheet requests on dialog open.
5. Type `::heart`; then enable the stock `emoticons` plugin and confirm `:` still yields emoji only.

**Decisions**
- No CDN calls for previews — components/custom glyphs come from data already in the JS bundle; only simple-icons and lucide-lab need their (self-contained) bundle sheets.
- Logos stay out of this picker.

## Plan: Replace TinyMCE emoticons icon picker with a custom dialog

Fix the upstream CSS defect that makes ~1,400 Instructure UI glyphs paint as black squares, then replace the emoticons-database picker with a purpose-built TinyMCE dialog that owns its own layout, chunked rendering, and zero-network glyph previews — keeping the emoji-like feel and a typing trigger.

**Steps**

**Phase 0 — Self-contained `icons.css`** *(independent; phases 1–5 don't block on it)*
- 0a. Emit `:root{--instui-icon-X:url(…)}` alongside the `.-icon-X` mapping in the aggregate `dist/icons.css`, via `iconGlyphsCss()` in [formats/components/src/utilities/icon-glyphs/index.ts](formats/components/src/utilities/icon-glyphs/index.ts) / [formats/components/scripts/build-icon-entries.ts](formats/components/scripts/build-icon-entries.ts). Matches what `dist/icons/<name>.css` and the three plugin bundles already do.
- 0b. Audit consumers first (docs theme, `packages/cdn`, bundler plugins, `ai/pantoken-ai`) for anything assuming the mapping-only shape.
- 0c. Drift test: every `.-icon-X` class has a matching `:root` token.
- 0d. Separate changeset — this is a user-visible payload change.

**Phase 1 — Data layer** ([renderers/tinymce/src/icons.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/icons.ts))
1. Drop `EmoticonEntry`, `buildEmoticonsDatabase`, `PANTOKEN_ICONS_DATABASE_ID`, `matchInsertedIcon`.
2. Add pure `filterIcons(icons, query, source)` and `SOURCE_LABELS`.
3. Add `getIconDataUri(icon)` — in-bundle SVG for components/custom, else read `--instui-icon-<name>` off `documentElement` via `getComputedStyle` and unwrap with `decodeIconToken` from [renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/icon-pack.ts).

**Phase 2 — Preview CSS** (new `lib/icon-preview-css.ts`) *depends on 3*
4. One idempotent `injectPickerStyles(doc)`: painter rule **scoped to the picker root**, a generated `:root` block from in-bundle data, and `<link>`s for only the two bundles not in the JS. Dialog open = 2 requests total.

**Phase 3 — Dialog DOM** (new `lib/icon-picker-dom.ts`)
5. `renderPickerMarkup()` — search input, source tabs, scrollable grid, live count, sentinel; `pantoken-ip__*` namespace.
6. `mountPicker(root, icons, { onPick })` — debounced search, 200-tile chunks via IntersectionObserver, roving tabindex. Tiles built with `createElement`, never string interpolation.

**Phase 4 — Plugin rewrite** ([renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/icons.ts))
7. `windowManager.open` with one `htmlpanel`; mount on open, `destroy()` on close — same dialog shape as [renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/components.ts](renderers/tinymce/src/plugins/components.ts).
8. On pick: `insertHtml` via `lib/insertion-target.ts` + `trackAndInjectAsset`; the `ExecCommand` / `data-pantoken-icon` round trip goes away.
9. Keep the `pantokenIcons` button and menu item.
10. `addAutocompleter` with configurable `trigger`, default `"::"`; rows are `cardmenuitem` + `CardImage` (data URI `src`) + name/source text, degrading to text-only. *depends on 3, 8*

**Phase 5 — Integration**
11. Strings in `strings.ts` + `l10n/tinymce.strings.pot`.
12. Update `plugins/pantoken.ts` and `src/index.ts`.
13. Remove `emoticons` / `emoticons_database_id` from demos, README, `ai/pantoken-ai`, scaffold templates.
14. Changeset; amend `ASSURANCE.md` for the runtime-`<style>` and htmlpanel surfaces.

**Verification**
0. Rebuild components; assert `dist/icons.css` contains both `--instui-icon-heart:url(` and `.-icon-heart{`; docs site still renders.
1. Package unit tests (happy-dom): `filterIcons`, `getIconDataUri`, tile construction, chunking.
2. `vp check --fix`, `vp run ready`, `pnpm run check:publish`; `vp test --coverage` last (≥85%).
3. **Manual browser pass:** no black squares in the Instructure UI tab, uniform tiles, smooth scroll through 6.8k icons, search spans sources, insert lands in body *and* CodeMirror source view.
4. Network panel: exactly 2 stylesheet requests on dialog open.
5. `::heart` inserts; with the stock `emoticons` plugin also enabled, `:` still yields emoji only.

**Decisions**
- Previews use data already in the JS bundle; only Simple Icons and Lucide Lab need their bundle sheets.
- `icons.css` grows to ~1 MB and may duplicate tokens for consumers who also load the tokens sheet — identical values, last-wins, bytes only. Accepted for consistency with the sibling bundles.
- Logos excluded; emoticons fully replaced but collision-free with the stock emoji plugin.
